job.title: Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS (all genders)

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms like SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris). Strong background in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, and system integrations between PIM, ERP, and OMS. Proven expertise in performance tuning, database optimization, and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with German language skills at B1 level.

cover_en.subject: Application: Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS (all genders)
cover_en.hook: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Developer position at adesso SE, bringing over 5 years of professional backend experience specializing in enterprise e-commerce platforms such as SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell.

bullets.label: Enterprise E-Commerce & OMS
bullets.text: Developed and maintained core SAP Hybris modules including the Promotions Engine, FlexibleSearch queries, Cronjobs, Impex scripts, and Order Management (OMS).

bullets.label: System Integration & APIs
bullets.text: Built and exposed RESTful APIs, OCC Web Services, and integrated external services, handling data pipelines between PIM, ERP, and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Performance & Scalability
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, while assessing platform stability during production support.

bullets.label: Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed backend functionality using Java and Spring, following platform best practices, design patterns, and executing CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2.

cover_en.gap: While my primary expertise lies in SAP Commerce Cloud and Java rather than Salesforce B2B Commerce and Apex, I possess a strong foundation in enterprise e-commerce architectures, REST APIs, and OMS, and I am very keen to learn Salesforce technologies.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German residence and work permit, and am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, making me available to start from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing my profile with you in an interview.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at adesso SE because of your strong focus on optimizing core business processes through tailored IT solutions and your collaborative, values-driven culture. I am eager to apply my 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce and backend development experience to support your ambitious technical projects while continuing my professional growth in an innovative environment.
tailoring.motivation_short: With 5+ years of enterprise e-commerce experience in Java and Spring, I am eager to bring my expertise in system integrations, APIs, and OMS to adesso SE and contribute to your scalable digital solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years in enterprise e-commerce development (Java, Spring, REST APIs, OMS), I am very interested in the Developer role at adesso SE. I hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16.12.2026. I'd love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS (all genders) - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents, including my CV and cover letter, for the Developer Salesforce B2B Commerce & OMS position at adesso SE.

With over 5 years of backend and enterprise e-commerce experience using Java, Spring, REST APIs, and OMS, I am confident in my ability to contribute to your technical projects. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
